_comment: cooldown and castTime are in simulation seconds. Requirement: check = inventory | placed | stat | unlocked | epoch | host, filtered by item or category, condition = gt | gte | lt | lte | eq. 'craft' is enabled when any recipe is affordable and 'sort_inventory' when the inventory is unsorted (special-cased in code, like PlayerAction#update_disabled). revealRequirements unlock an action for good once met (tech tree), retireRequirements retire it for good, and requirements are checked every time. 'places' makes a seeding action: it creates that overdensity in the selected cell or deepens the one there. Any other action with a lootTable just rolls it.

actions.name: perturb
actions.label: Perturb
actions.tooltip: Stretch a quantum fluctuation across the selected cell. It seeds a ripple (an overdensity) there, or deepens the one already there. The energy comes out of the host black hole.

actions.name: feed
actions.label: Feed the Horizon
actions.tooltip: Pour matter from the facility across the event horizon. The host black hole regains mass, and the heavier it is, the slower it evaporates.

actions.name: craft
actions.label: Craft
actions.tooltip: Craft items from your gathered materials.

actions.name: use
actions.label: Use
actions.tooltip: Use the selected item. Select a quantum cache in your inventory, then Use to open it.

actions.name: deploy
actions.label: Deploy
actions.tooltip: Deploy the selected item into the selected grid cell.

actions.name: recall
actions.label: Recall
actions.tooltip: Recall a deployed entity from the selected grid cell back into your inventory.

actions.name: load
actions.label: Load
actions.tooltip: Load the selected quantum cache or radiation source into the irradiation enclosure in the selected cell.

actions.name: unload
actions.label: Unload
actions.tooltip: Take the cache and source out of the irradiation enclosure in the selected cell.

actions.name: sort_inventory
actions.label: Sort
actions.tooltip: Automatically sort and consolidate your inventory slots.

actions.name: annihilate
actions.label: Annihilate
actions.tooltip: Annihilate the whole stack in the selected inventory slot. It is gone for good.
